symptom: v0.3–v0.6 regressions need benchmarks/checkouts/*, which is gitignored and was never recreated by any script; a clean checkout silently reports 0 tasks as N/A / recall 0
rootCause: pinned repositories were cloned by hand during development (hidden state)
fix: benchmarks/fetch-checkouts.ts (npm run benchmark:checkouts) fetches each pinned commit (sparse for keycloak); benchmark:v03 runs it first

step: [v0.9] README tarball validation in a fresh clone
symptom: `npm pack` fails in a fresh clone because prepack runs tsc before dependencies are installed; README also named context-slice-0.8.0.tgz and said 'Only Java source is supported in v0.7' / 'After linking ContextSlice'
rootCause: README written from an already-installed development checkout
fix: README adds `npm ci` before `npm pack`, names the current tarball, and drops stale version wording
regressionTest: tests/package-metadata.test.ts (README tarball name matches package version)

step: [v0.9] git status in target repository after init
symptom: `?? .context-slice/` appears in the developer's git status
rootCause: cache directory was not ignored and ContextSlice (correctly) does not edit the repository .gitignore
fix: cache directory writes its own `.gitignore` containing `*`; also applied to caches created by 0.8.0 on first use after upgrade

symptom: v0.8 report printed 'Path with spaces: false' and 'Nested cwd: false' while claiming status pass
rootCause: macOS tmpdir is a symlink (/var -> /private/var); the check compared the symlinked path with the real path the CLI reports
fix: smoke test uses realpathSync for its workspace

symptom: no documented way to remove repository caches; uninstall leaves them
fix: README documents `rm -rf .context-slice`; no `clean` command added (one rm is simpler than a new CLI surface)
regressionTest: clean-room RC run (uninstall step verifies cache retention)

symptom: `status` on a never-initialized repository creates an empty .context-slice/ cache while reporting UNINITIALIZED
rootCause: IndexStorage opens (and creates) the SQLite cache on every command
fix: accepted: the directory is self-ignored and contains no source; documented that ContextSlice only writes to .context-slice/

symptom: a non-SQLite index.sqlite produced `INTERNAL_ERROR: file is not a database` (exit 1) and advised `context-slice doctor`, which fails the same way
rootCause: SQLite open errors were not mapped to the existing INDEX_CORRUPT workflow error
fix: IndexStorage raises INDEX_CORRUPT (exit 2) with remediation `rm -rf .context-slice && context-slice init`
regressionTest: tests/cache.test.ts (corrupt cache fails with an actionable INDEX_CORRUPT error)

step: [v0.9] Codex integration (codex exec with command context-slice, args [mcp])
symptom: codex-cli 0.153.4 ended the turn with 'You've hit your usage limit' before any MCP tool call
rootCause: assistant account quota on this host, not ContextSlice
fix: none needed in ContextSlice; the RC script now reports a pre-tool runtime failure as DEFERRED instead of FAIL. Rerun `npm run release:rc -- --assistants` once quota resets

step: [v0.9] preview on spring-petclinic: "explain the owner update flow"
symptom: target resolves to OwnerController.initUpdateOwnerForm (the GET form handler) with 1 item / 32 tokens, and no callers or callees; processUpdateOwnerForm is the more useful target
rootCause: task-text target ranking prefers the first matching handler; ranking changes are feature work outside v0.9 scope
fix: accepted for v0.9; name the symbol in the task (e.g. "explain processUpdateOwnerForm") for a richer slice

symptom: package version moved 0.9.0 -> 1.0.0; README, CHANGELOG, release notes and tests reference the new tarball name
rootCause: planned release step, not a defect
fix: package.json is the single source of truth; tests/package-metadata.test.ts asserts the version and that README names context-slice-<version>.tgz
